name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; accurately describes opening the character status panel with a slide-in entrance animation. No address residue in the name. Verdict confirmed against decompilation (descending 0xB->0 frame loop = entrance) and caller fd2_open_char_status_screen which passes char_idx straight through.
purpose: Open the character status panel for one party member with a 12-frame slide-in animation.
logic_summary: __CHK(0x18) stack probe. Allocates three 64000-byte (320x200 mode 13h) workspaces: a (per-frame interpolated accumulator), b (pristine VRAM snapshot), c (rendered status-panel target). memmove backs up VRAM 0xA0000 into b, copies b into c, then renders the static status layout (fd2_render_status_screen_static_layout) and the inventory item grid (fd2_render_inventory_item_grid with item_id -1 = no highlight) into c. Loops frame from 0xB down to 0, firing a chime SFX (fd2_play_sfx_with_handle, sfx 5) at frame 0xB and frame 5, and calling the shared fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step(frame, a, c, b) each frame -- the same step used for the slide-out, but with the frame index descending, which produces the entrance. Finally drains the keyboard buffer (fd2_clear_keyboard_buffer). Counterpart open/close is fd2_open_char_status_screen / its outro.

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Character (party member) index whose status panel is opened; passed straight to fd2_render_status_screen_static_layout and fd2_render_inventory_item_grid. Callers (fd2_open_char_status_screen, fd2_inventory_selection_modal_dispatch, fd2_equip_unequip_inventory_menu) all forward their own char_idx unchanged. src already names it char_idx.
params.reason: Live Ghidra parameter is the generic placeholder param_1; it is the character index. src/ already uses char_idx. Stage 2 should rename the Ghidra parameter to char_idx to match.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the rendered status panel left on screen plus three workspace buffers allocated into the data_fd2_ui_slide_*_buf_ptr globals (freed later by fd2_open_char_status_screen).

comment_original_issue: src comment was correct and ASCII-clean but did not explain that the slide-in reuses the shared fd2_play_status_screen_outro_step with the frame index running backwards, which could read as a bug (a slide-in calling an 'outro' step).
notes: Plate is consistent with refined understanding (it already documents the descending 0xB->0 frame loop and the 3-buffer roles), so plate left untouched (ghidra_plate_action=none); no save_program needed. The only Stage-2 action is the parameter rename param_1 -> char_idx. The three workspace buffers are allocated here but freed by fd2_open_char_status_screen (asymmetric ownership by design, confirmed in caller decompilation).
